label: Dates
summary: Date conversion, formatting, and date arithmetic helpers.
must_follow: Use documented date conversion functions rather than assuming implicit coercion.
Keep canonical casing for LIMSDate, DOW, and DOY.
Be explicit about invariant/local date handling when database result materialization depends on it.
avoid: Do not pass arbitrary strings or numbers to date-only functions unless the element documentation says they are accepted.

elements.name: LIMSDate
elements.summary: Returns a date value as a formatted string.

elements.name: CToD
elements.summary: Converts a string in the current SSL date format to a date value.

elements.name: DToC
elements.summary: Converts a date value to a string using the current SSL date format.

elements.name: DToS
elements.summary: Converts a date value to an 8-character string in yyyyMMdd format.

elements.name: DateAdd
elements.summary: Adds a time interval to a date and returns the resulting date.

elements.name: DateDiff
elements.summary: Returns the whole-number difference between two date values in a requested unit.

elements.name: DateFormat
elements.summary: Sets the current SSL date format string.

elements.name: DateFromString
elements.summary: Parses a string into a date value with optional format and culture controls.

elements.name: DateToString
elements.summary: Converts a date value to a string using a specified or default format.

elements.name: Day
elements.summary: Extracts the day-of-month number from a date value.

elements.name: Month
elements.summary: Extracts the numeric month from a date value.

elements.name: Year
elements.summary: Extracts the numeric year from a date value.

elements.name: DOW
elements.summary: Returns the numeric day of week for a date.

elements.name: DOY
elements.summary: Calculates the ordinal day number of a date within its year.
